title.bn: ধাপে ধাপে সি আউটপুট বোঝার অনুশীলন

summary.en: Work through 32 defined-output programs grouped by operators, loops, pointers, strings, macros and static state.
summary.bn: Operator, loop, pointer, string, macro ও static state মিলিয়ে ৩২টি বৈধ প্রোগ্রামের আউটপুট ধাপে বোঝো।

sections.title: Check validity before predicting a value
Explain the rule behind each line

examples.title: Integer division before conversion
examples.explanationHtml: a/b is integer three before the first cast. Casting a before division makes the second quotient 3.5.

examples.title: Short-circuit AND skips an update
examples.explanationHtml: The first condition is false, so ++n is not evaluated. Both result and n remain zero.

examples.title: Short-circuit OR skips an update
examples.explanationHtml: The first condition is true, so the second operand is skipped. A logical result is one rather than the original four.

examples.title: Bitwise selection differs from logical truth
examples.explanationHtml: Binary 110 AND 011 selects bit one, giving two. Both operands are nonzero, so logical AND gives one.

examples.title: Conditional operator chooses one update
examples.explanationHtml: Only the false branch runs because two is not above eight. y becomes nine and the chosen value is nine.

examples.title: Comma operator sequences two steps
examples.explanationHtml: The comma operator completes x += 2 first. Its right expression then computes nine from x equal to three.

examples.title: Loop counter after the final failed condition
examples.explanationHtml: The body adds one, two and three. The last increment leaves i at four, where the condition fails.

examples.title: Continue still reaches the for increment
examples.explanationHtml: Even values skip addition but still reach the increment. The sum is one plus three plus five.

examples.title: Break preserves the current counter
examples.explanationHtml: The break exits immediately at two. The for increment does not run after that break.

examples.title: A do loop executes before testing
examples.explanationHtml: The body runs once before the false condition is tested. n therefore becomes one despite starting at zero.

examples.title: Nested triangular iteration count
examples.explanationHtml: The inner loop runs one, two and three times. Adding those row lengths gives six.

examples.title: A post-decrement condition changes the final state
examples.explanationHtml: The body runs for old values three, two and one. The final comparison uses old zero but still decrements n to minus one.

examples.title: Post-incrementing the pointer rather than its element
examples.explanationHtml: The old pointer is dereferenced for ten. The pointer then advances to the element containing twenty.

examples.title: Incrementing an element through a pointer
examples.explanationHtml: The pointed-to int becomes eleven. The pointer itself remains at the first element.

examples.title: Pointer subtraction counts elements
examples.explanationHtml: Both pointers belong to the same array. Their difference counts two int elements, not a byte distance.

examples.title: A pointer-to-pointer replaces the selected pointer
examples.explanationHtml: Assigning through link changes p to name b. It does not change the separate int object a.

examples.title: One-past is a boundary rather than an element
examples.explanationHtml: The one-past pointer may be formed and subtracted within this array. Moving back one reaches the final element nine.

examples.title: Terminating a mutable string early
examples.explanationHtml: Writing the terminator at index two makes the visible string ma. strlen stops there even though later array bytes still exist.

examples.title: A string view begins at an interior character
examples.explanationHtml: Index two is the a after Dh. The view prints from that character through the existing terminator.

examples.title: sizeof includes the terminator in an array
examples.explanationHtml: The array has room for three letters and a terminator. The string length excludes the terminator.

examples.title: memmove permits overlapping ranges
examples.explanationHtml: The three source letters abc are copied safely into indices one through three. The original terminator at four remains, producing aabc.

examples.title: Compare string content by the sign of strcmp
examples.explanationHtml: The differing characters are eight and nine; decimal digit order is guaranteed. The comparison is negative; only its sign is used.

examples.title: Parenthesise a complete macro replacement
examples.explanationHtml: The grouped addition is evaluated before multiplication. A macro replacement used as an expression needs equivalent grouping.

examples.title: Observe a deliberately ungrouped replacement
examples.explanationHtml: SUM_BAD expands to 2 + 1 without enclosing parentheses. The expression becomes 3 * 2 + 1, so multiplication happens first.

examples.title: A grouped square macro handles an expression operand
examples.explanationHtml: Parenthesised parameter occurrences and the complete replacement preserve the intended square. The operand has no side effects.

examples.title: Conditional compilation chooses a branch before execution
examples.explanationHtml: FEATURE_VALUE is defined as seven in the selected preprocessor branch. The unselected source branch is not a runtime alternative.

examples.title: A function avoids repeating an argument side effect
examples.explanationHtml: The function argument is evaluated once, supplying three, and i becomes four. twice computes six from its local parameter.

examples.title: A static local is initialised once
examples.explanationHtml: The static local starts at zero once and persists. Separate calls return one and then two.

examples.title: An automatic local starts fresh on each call
examples.explanationHtml: Each call creates and initialises a new local count. Both calls increment their own zero to one.

examples.title: Block shadowing does not replace a static object
examples.explanationHtml: The inner automatic count shadows the static name only within its block. The static object is then incremented separately across calls.

examples.title: Zero-initialised static arrays retain assignments
examples.explanationHtml: Static storage is zero-initialised before execution. Only the middle element changes to four.

examples.title: A static accumulator keeps earlier contributions
examples.explanationHtml: The first call stores three in the persistent total. The second adds five to that total and returns eight.

keyPoints.en: Expand macros and apply precedence before computing results.
keyPoints.bn: Macro expand করে precedence মেনে তারপর হিসাব করো।

keyPoints.en: Track pointer movement separately from pointed-to data changes.
keyPoints.bn: পয়েন্টার সরানো আর তার ডেটা বদলানো আলাদা করে লেখো।

keyPoints.en: String length, array capacity and terminator position are different facts.
keyPoints.bn: স্ট্রিংয়ের দৈর্ঘ্য, অ্যারের capacity ও terminator-এর position আলাদা তথ্য।

keyPoints.en: Static local state persists, while automatic locals are created per call.
keyPoints.bn: Static local-এর মান থাকে; automatic local প্রতিবার call-এ নতুন হয়।

keyPoints.en: Undefined behavior must be identified rather than assigned an invented output.
keyPoints.bn: Undefined behavior চিনে কারণ বলো; বানানো আউটপুট ধরে নিও না।
